title: S3: the engine's one-cell Xenopus egg with its furrow and restricted cleft against R-full
status: PROPOSED (draft by the S3 agent, 13 November 2026; not registered). The values wait for the development runs (the dt study and R-full's reference terms), which wait for the lead's approval; the tolerance rule is the plan's (docs/CELL_DIVISION_S3_PLAN.md §4) and is not chosen from any run
purpose: Qualify the engine's cleft egg against the registered independent reference R-full on J1's state and trajectory. Not a J1 verdict against the data (J1 was judged on R-full on 12 November).

definition_source.egg: validation/division/cleft_egg_reference.py build(declared inputs, scalar_values(declared inputs), p_old = the record's p_old_m_s, a_over_l = the record's a_over_l_m): R-full's own egg, written by cleft_egg_engine.definition
definition_source.schedule: the default (uniform) schedule only: the furrow opens at 420 s with A_on = 1e-9 m2 and grows at r = (A_J1 - A_on) / (1800 s - 420 s) to the 2100 s horizon; the back-loaded band member is out of S3's comparison (plan §6)
definition_source.electrode: one electrode in the egg; rm_definition's pulse train (3e-8 A, 1.2 s, every 10 s, alternating from t = 0 positive) throughout, carried by K 0.4912 and Cl 0.5088 (rm_definition.injected_carrier_fractions, the field R-full's Pulses read)
definition_source.solver: imex_ars222_face_electromigration@1, run in vector windows with device checks on every row
definition_source.field_comparison: cleft_egg_engine compare: 30 fields, 26 exactly R-full's, 2 within 1e-12 (unit conversion and one-ulp event times), 2 declared (the cytosol charge anchor and initial potential at 3.9e-11 relative, the consistent anchor's egg-scale granularity, bound 1.1e-9); /mnt/workspaces/Cells/cell-division-s3-20261113-01/step1-tests/compare.json

quantities.Q1_em_at_j1_V: V at the front edge of pulse 180 (1800 s, J1), the old membrane's voltage (cytosol minus bath)
quantities.Q2_rm_at_j1_ohm: Rm of the pair (179, 180): (|dV_179| + |dV_180|) / (2 x 3e-8 A), dV_k = V(t_k + 1.0 s) - V(t_k) (rm_definition)
quantities.Q3_rm1_ohm: Rm of the pair (0, 1), before the onset; reported, not judged (judged on the uncleaved egg in injection's acceptance)
quantities.Q4_em_trajectory_V: V at the front edge of every pulse, 0 to 210; compared by the maximum |engine - R-full| over the pulses, and its terms are maxima over the pulses
quantities.Q5_lumen_K_mM: the lumen's K at J1 (mM, activity basis): the engine's observer reads the lumen filled to its patch's area at 1800 s, (n + c_b (T - dV)) / (V_on + T) with T = w (A - A_on) / 2, which is R-full's lumen (volume w A / 2 exactly); restricted_cleft_lumen@1's lumen_concentration_mM
quantities.Q5_lumen_Na_mM: the lumen's Na at J1, as Q5_lumen_K_mM

reference: R-full (validation/division/cleft_egg_reference.py simulate to the 2100 s horizon) under the registered defaults (Radau, rtol 1e-10, split at every pulse edge and sample time) at the record's calibration, recomputed for each quantity by cleft_egg_engine reference from the snapshot the lead names; Q1, Q2 and Q3 are checked there against the record (prediction_of_record_V, rm_at_j1_ohm, rm1_ohm)
engine_step_term_rule: |Q(0.25 ms) - Q(0.125 ms)| per quantity (Q4: the maximum over pulses), from three development runs (cleft_egg_engine study, then terms); the observed order log2(|Q(0.5 ms) - Q(0.25 ms)| / |Q(0.25 ms) - Q(0.125 ms)|) is checked per quantity (about 2 for ARS(2,2,2))
reference_term_rule: max |Q(variant) - Q(default)| over R-full's Radau rtol 1e-8, BDF rtol 1e-10, LSODA rtol 1e-10 and activation area 1e-10 m2 (J1's reference_numerics, as part_record forms them); Q4: the maximum over pulses and variants
tolerance_rule: 3 x (engine step term + reference term), per quantity (the rule Rm1's registered protocol uses)
verdict_rule: pass when every judged |engine(judged dt) - R-full| is within its tolerance (Q4: the maximum over pulses); a failure is recorded and diagnosed, never retuned
stop_rule: before registration: stop and report if the study shows no convergence or the energy ledger fails at an admitted step; an implicit membrane-cleft term would then be a new solver version (division design §5.4). Observed orders are reported and inspected (about 2 for ARS(2,2,2))
stop_condition: registered by the lead, 13 November: stop and report (non-convergence under the plan's stop rule) if any judged quantity's step term fails to decrease from the (0.5, 0.25 ms) pair to the (0.25, 0.125 ms) pair; a step term that is 0 at both pairs does not stop. Evaluated by cleft_egg_engine terms (stop, non_converging); fill refuses a study that met it

evidence.probe: /mnt/workspaces/Cells/cell-division-s3-20261113-01/probe/ (the bounded ledger probe through the onset plus 1e5 steps at 0.25 ms; no Q quantity)

judged_run: once, on CPU, after registration, from a clean execution snapshot of main (validation/source_snapshot.py; no dirty patch); the driver refuses an unregistered protocol and a run outside a clean snapshot; the protocol records the judged step and the commit
